Website Migration & SEO Recovery

Website Migration SEO Services to Protect Rankings and Recover Lost Visibility

Moving a website to a new domain, platform, hosting provider, or website structure can affect search visibility when SEO details are missed during the migration process. Broken URLs, missing redirects, indexing problems, changed content, and technical errors can all contribute to lost rankings after migration.

Our website migration SEO services help businesses identify migration-related SEO risks, protect important search signals during a planned move, and investigate websites where traffic or rankings dropped after a migration.

Whether you are planning a migration or already experiencing website migration SEO issues, we review the technical and SEO factors that may be affecting your website.

Migration SEO Audit | Redirect Review | Indexing Checks | SEO Recovery Support

Migration SEO Planning

Review SEO risks before moving your website

Redirect Management

Check important old and new URL connections

Technical SEO Audit

Identify crawl, indexing, and migration-related errors

SEO Recovery

Investigate ranking and visibility losses after migration

Book a Free Consultation

Since 2013

Website repair & SEO recovery experience

1,000+ Websites

Repaired across multiple industries

24/7 Support

Emergency help — call or text anytime

Since 2013

Houston-based, serving clients nationwide

Why Website Migration Can Affect SEO

A website migration involves more than moving files from one server to another. Search engines may need to process changes involving URLs, domains, page structures, internal links, content, and technical configurations.

If important SEO elements are changed or missed, you may experience:

  • Rankings dropped after website migration
  • Lost organic traffic
  • Important pages disappearing from search results
  • Broken or missing redirects
  • 404 errors
  • Duplicate content issues
  • Incorrect canonical tags
  • Pages blocked from crawling or indexing
  • XML sitemap problems
  • Internal links pointing to old URLs
  • Changes to metadata or page content
  • Domain or HTTPS configuration issues

Our SEO migration services focus on reviewing these areas before, during, or after a website migration.

How We Work

Our process is clear, efficient, and built around your needs

01

Free Consultation

We start by reviewing your site and identifying the problems — whether it’s SEO, loading speed, DNS errors, or broken features.

02

Live Diagnosis

We schedule a live session (via phone, Zoom, or Google Meet) to walk you through the issues and explain what needs fixing.

03

Secure Backup

Before making any changes, we take a complete backup of your site to ensure your data is protected.

04

Fast Repairs

Most issues are resolved within 1–3 business days. We fix, test, and verify every change for full functionality.

05

Ongoing Support

After the job is done, we offer guidance, reports, and optional ongoing support to keep your site running strong.

SEO Migration Services for Planned Website Moves

If your website migration has not happened yet, it is important to review the SEO impact before making major changes.

We can help assess the migration plan and identify pages, URLs, and search assets that need attention. This helps create a clearer process for preserving important SEO signals during the move.

Our migration support may include:

  • Pre-migration migration SEO audit
  • Important page and URL review
  • Existing ranking and traffic analysis
  • URL mapping recommendations
  • Redirect planning and review
  • Metadata and content checks
  • Internal linking review
  • Canonical tag review
  • XML sitemap preparation
  • Robots.txt review
  • HTTPS and domain migration checks
  • Search Console monitoring support
  • Post-launch SEO checks

The goal is to preserve SEO during migration as much as possible while reducing avoidable technical errors.

Lost Rankings After Migration? We Can Investigate the Problem

A temporary change in search performance can happen after a major website migration, but significant or continuing losses should be investigated.

If your rankings dropped after website migration, our team can review what changed and look for technical or SEO issues that may be contributing to the loss.

We compare important migration-related factors such as URL changes, redirects, page accessibility, indexing, content, metadata, canonicalization, and internal links.

Common Signs You May Need SEO Migration Recovery

  • Organic traffic dropped after launch
  • Previously ranking pages are no longer visible
  • Old URLs are returning errors
  • New pages are not being indexed
  • Redirects are missing or incorrect
  • Google is indexing the wrong URLs
  • Important content was removed during redesign
  • Search Console reports new coverage or indexing issues
  • Website rankings have not recovered after migration

Our SEO migration recovery process starts with diagnosing the problem before recommending the appropriate fixes.

Planning a Website Migration or Recovering From a Ranking Drop?

Tell us what changed and when the problem started. We can review your website migration and help identify the SEO issues affecting your search visibility.

Getting Started

Quick and hassle-free from the first call

Getting your WordPress website repaired is quick and hassle-free. Simply call us at 832-266-7209, or submit your contact information — and we’ll get back to you promptly.

Once we connect, we’ll schedule a live website review with you, either by phone, Zoom, or Google Meet (whichever works best). During this session, we’ll:

  • Review your website in real-time

  • Identify and explain the issues you’re facing

  • Provide a clear solution and expected timeline

  • Begin work immediately — after taking a full backup of your current website

We prioritize secure and transparent repairs, ensuring your website data and functionality are fully protected throughout the process. As a trusted USA-based website repair service, we understand how important your site is to your business — and we treat every repair with the urgency and care it deserves.

Speak to a Website Expert Now
FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions About Website Migration SEO Recovery

Still have questions?

Call or text us anytime — real experts, 24/7.

(832) 266 7209
What is website migration SEO?

Website migration SEO involves reviewing and managing SEO-related changes when moving a website to a new domain, platform, design, URL structure, or server. The goal is to reduce avoidable problems that could affect rankings, traffic, and indexing.

Why did my rankings drop after website migration?

Rankings can drop because of missing redirects, changed URLs, removed content, indexing problems, incorrect canonical tags, crawl errors, or other technical issues. A migration SEO audit can help identify what changed.

Can you help recover lost rankings after migration?

Yes. Our SEO migration recovery services involve reviewing the migration, identifying possible causes of lost visibility, and addressing relevant technical and SEO issues.

When should I start SEO work before a website migration?

Ideally, SEO planning should begin before the migration takes place. This allows important URLs, redirects, content, and technical SEO elements to be reviewed before the new website launches.

How long does SEO recovery after migration take?

The timeline depends on the issues involved, the size of the website, the type of migration, and how quickly search engines process the corrected changes. Some technical fixes can be implemented quickly, while ranking recovery may take longer.

Our Website Migration SEO Process

A successful migration requires checking SEO before and after the website goes live. Our SEO migration services follow a practical process to identify risks, monitor important changes, and address issues that may affect rankings.

1. Pre-Migration SEO Audit

Before the move, we review your current website to identify important pages, URLs, rankings, technical issues, and search assets that should be considered during the migration.

This migration SEO audit may include reviewing:

  • Important URLs and landing pages
  • Current indexing status
  • Redirect requirements
  • Metadata and page content
  • Canonical tags
  • Internal links
  • XML sitemaps and robots.txt
  • Existing technical SEO issues

2. URL Mapping and Redirect Review

When URLs change, old pages should be reviewed and mapped to the most relevant new pages where appropriate. We check redirect implementation to help visitors and search engines reach the correct destination.

3. Launch and Technical Checks

After migration, we review the new website for common technical problems, including broken pages, redirect errors, crawlability issues, indexing problems, canonical errors, and incorrect internal links.

4. Search Visibility Monitoring

We monitor important pages and search signals after launch to identify issues that may appear during the transition. This helps us investigate unexpected changes in indexing, traffic, or rankings.

5. SEO Recovery and Fixes

If you have already experienced lost rankings after migration, we investigate the likely causes and prioritize relevant fixes. Depending on the problem, this may involve redirects, indexing corrections, content recovery, technical fixes, or other SEO improvements.

Types of Website Migrations We Support

Different migrations create different SEO risks. Our website migration SEO support can be adapted to several types of website changes.

Domain Migration

Moving from one domain to another requires careful review of redirects, page connections, indexing, and other SEO signals.

Website Redesign

A redesign can affect rankings when important content, URLs, headings, internal links, or page structures change without proper planning.

Platform Migration

Moving from WordPress to another CMS, or between different website platforms, may change URLs, templates, technical settings, and other elements that affect SEO.

HTTP to HTTPS Migration

Moving to HTTPS requires correct implementation to avoid duplicate versions, indexing issues, or problems with internal links and redirects.

Hosting or Server Migration

A hosting move can create SEO issues if the website experiences downtime, crawl errors, incorrect server responses, or configuration problems.

Website Structure Changes

Changing page URLs, navigation, categories, or internal linking can affect how search engines discover and understand your website.

Migration SEO Recovery for Websites That Already Lost Traffic

Already completed your migration and noticed a drop in rankings or organic traffic? We can perform a focused review of the migration and investigate what may have changed.

Our SEO recovery after migration may include:

  • Comparing old and new URL structures
  • Checking redirect coverage
  • Reviewing indexed pages
  • Identifying 404 and server errors
  • Checking robots.txt and meta robots settings
  • Reviewing canonical tags
  • Finding broken internal links
  • Checking sitemap submission and coverage
  • Reviewing important content changes
  • Identifying pages that lost search visibility

We focus on finding the actual issues affecting the website rather than making unnecessary changes.

Why Choose Our SEO Migration Services?

A website migration can involve technical, content, and search visibility changes at the same time. Our approach focuses on identifying important SEO risks, reviewing the migration carefully, and fixing issues that may affect your organic traffic.

Migration Support Based on Your Website

Every website migration is different. We review your domain, platform, URL structure, website size, and current SEO condition before determining the appropriate scope of work.

Technical and SEO Review

We look beyond the visual appearance of the new website. Our review can cover redirects, crawlability, indexing, internal links, canonical tags, sitemaps, and other migration-related SEO factors.

Support Before or After Migration

Whether you are planning a website move or dealing with lost rankings after migration, we can review your situation and recommend the next steps.

Clear Problem Diagnosis

If rankings have dropped, we focus on identifying what changed and where the problems may be occurring before recommending unnecessary SEO work.

Need Help With Website Migration SEO?

A website migration should not mean starting your SEO efforts from zero. Whether you are moving to a new domain, redesigning your website, changing platforms, or recovering from a traffic drop, our team can help review the SEO side of the process.

Get a Migration SEO Audit and Find Out What Needs Attention

Tell us about your planned or completed migration. We can review your website, identify potential website migration SEO issues, and discuss the steps needed to protect or recover your search visibility.

Did Your Rankings Drop After a Website Migration?

We can review what changed, identify possible migration SEO issues, and help you take the right steps toward protecting or recovering your search visibility.

Let's Have A Free Consultation

Call or text us — we’ll review your website live and give you a clear plan and a free, no-obligation quote.
